samples.scenario: Azure Blob Storage Container Set to Public Access Allowing Anonymous Read Access to Confidential Financial Reports

technical_data.azure_cli_commands:
# Check container ACL
az storage container show --name confidential-reports --account-name financestorageaccount

# Download blob anonymously
curl https://financestorageaccount.blob.core.windows.net/confidential-reports/financial_report_q1_2024.pdf -o financial_report_q1_2024.pdf

indicators: Blob container ACL set to public access level "blob" allowing anonymous read
Azure Activity Log showing setAccessPolicy action changing public access on sensitive container
Storage Analytics logs showing anonymous GET requests from external IPs
Financial PDF reports containing sensitive business data accessed without authentication
IAM roles allowing broad permissions on storage account blob services
Use of curl commands downloading blobs without authentication
samples.detection_method: Automated scanning of Azure Blob container access policies for public access settings; correlation of Azure Activity Logs for setAccessPolicy operations granting public access; analysis of Storage Analytics logs for anonymous read operations; monitoring role assignments granting broad storage permissions; alerting on downloads of sensitive blobs from unusual IPs or anonymous users.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: Google Cloud Storage Bucket Configured with Uniform Bucket-Level Access Disabled, Allowing Legacy Public Access to Internal Employee Records

technical_data.gcloud_cli_commands:
# Get bucket IAM policy
 gcloud storage buckets get-iam-policy employee-records

# Download public file
curl https://storage.googleapis.com/employee-records/employee_list.csv -o employee_list.csv

indicators: Bucket IAM policy includes 'allUsers' member with roles/storage.objectViewer role
Audit logs showing setIamPolicy API call granting public read access
Access logs showing GET requests for sensitive employee data from public IP addresses
CSV files containing employee PII and salary data publicly accessible
IAM roles allowing excessive storage admin rights to a single user
Use of curl commands to download files anonymously from GCS bucket
samples.detection_method: Regular audits of Google Cloud Storage bucket IAM policies to detect 'allUsers' or 'allAuthenticatedUsers' bindings; monitoring Cloud Audit Logs for setIamPolicy calls granting public access; analyzing access logs for unauthorized anonymous reads; reviewing IAM role assignments for privilege creep; enabling Uniform Bucket-Level Access and alerting on policy changes that disable it.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: Google Cloud Storage Bucket with Public Read ACL Exposing Internal Financial Reports

technical_data.gcloud_cli_commands:
# Check bucket ACLs
gcloud storage buckets get-iam-policy internal-financials

# Download file
gsutil cp gs://internal-financials/2023_Q4_report.xlsx ./

indicators: Bucket ACL grants READER role to allUsers entity
Audit log shows update to bucket ACL adding public read permissions by finance-admin@example.com
GCS access logs show GET requests from external IP 203.0.113.101 fetching sensitive financial report
Downloaded Excel report contains internal financial data
IAM policy bindings include roles/storage.objectViewer granted to allUsers
Use of gsutil command from external IP address
samples.detection_method: Continuous monitoring of bucket ACLs and IAM policies for public access bindings; analyzing Cloud Audit Logs for bucket policy changes granting allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers roles; correlating GCS access logs for unusual external IP downloads of sensitive data; alerting on large data egress volumes; enforcing uniform bucket-level access and disabling legacy ACLs where possible.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: Azure Blob Storage Container with Container Public Access Level Set to 'Blob' Exposing Confidential Project Documents

technical_data.sample_sensitive_data_file:
Document Title: Confidential Project Plan
Version: 2.3
Author: Jane Doe
Details: Project timeline, budget estimates, and resource allocation
technical_data.azure_cli_commands:
# Check container access level
az storage container show --name project-documents --account-name contosostorage

# Download confidential document
az storage blob download --container-name project-documents --name confidential_plan.pdf --file ./confidential_plan.pdf --account-name contosostorage

indicators: Blob container public access level set to 'Blob' allowing anonymous read access
Azure Activity Log records SetBlobServiceProperties operation changing publicAccess to Blob by project-admin@contoso.com
Blob service logs show GET requests from external IP 198.51.100.101 retrieving confidential_plan.pdf
Confidential PDF document with sensitive project details publicly accessible
Role assignments include Storage Blob Data Contributor to project-admin@contoso.com enabling container modification
Azure CLI and Storage Explorer usage from external IP 203.0.113.78 modifying container ACLs
samples.detection_method: Monitoring Azure Activity Logs for changes to blob container public access settings; scanning for containers with publicAccess set to 'Blob' or 'Container'; analyzing blob service logs for anonymous or external IP GET requests; auditing role assignments for excessive permissions; enforcing Azure Storage firewall rules and private endpoints; alerting on unexpected data downloads from public containers.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
